function Kd takes nothing returns nothing
	local unit u=GetEnumUnit()
	set bj_forLoopAIndex=bj_forLoopAIndex+1

		call jd(CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(u),GetUnitTypeId(bj_lastCreatedUnit),GetUnitX(bj_lastCreatedUnit),GetUnitY(bj_lastCreatedUnit),.0),bj_lastLoadedUnit)

handlers.name: ld
handlers.body:
function ld takes unit u,unit Jd returns nothing
	local player p=GetOwningPlayer(Jd)
	local integer GI=GetPlayerId(p)
	local boolean kd=GetUnitAbilityLevel(Jd,'B01K')>0
	local group sg
	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0DZ')>0)then
		call ShowUnit(u,false)
		call IssueImmediateOrderById(u,$D02BB)
		call UnitApplyTimedLife(u,'BTLF',1.)
	endif
	if(kd)then
		call UnitAddAbility(u,'A09M')
		call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A09M',3)
		call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A09M')
		call UnitAddAbility(u,'A09Q')
		call UnitAddAbility(u,'A09R')
	endif
	call gB(u)
	set Mi[GI]=Mi[GI]+1
	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A07M')>=1)then
		call NB(u)
		call GroupAddUnit(er,u)
	elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A09H')>0)then
		call jd(CreateUnit(p,GetUnitTypeId(u),GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u),.0),Jd)
	elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0FO')>0)then
		call jd(CreateUnit(p,'n02K',GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u),.0),Jd)
		call jd(CreateUnit(p,'n02L',GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u),.0),Jd)
	endif
	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A070')<=0)then
		set bj_lastCreatedUnit=u
		set bj_lastLoadedUnit=Jd
		set bj_forLoopAIndex=0
		call ForGroup(Hi[ea[GI]],function Kd)
	endif
	if(Ei)then
		set sg=LoadGroupHandle(Gr,'SyGr',GetHandleId(Jd))
		if(sg!=null)then
			set nr=GetUnitBuildTime(GetUnitTypeId(u))
			call ForGroup(sg,function Hd)
			set sg=null
			call TriggerSleepAction(.3)
			call PauseUnit(Jd,true)
			call TriggerSleepAction(.3)
			call PauseUnit(Jd,false)
		endif
	endif
	set sg=null
endfunction

handlers.name: jd
handlers.body:
function jd takes unit u,unit Jd returns nothing
	local player p=GetOwningPlayer(Jd)
	local integer GI=GetPlayerId(p)
	local boolean kd=GetUnitAbilityLevel(Jd,'B01K')>0
	
	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0DZ')>0)then
		call IssueImmediateOrderById(u,$D02BB)
		call UnitApplyTimedLife(u,'BTLF',1.)
		set u = GetSummonedUnit()
		if(u==null)then
			return
		endif
	endif
	if(kd)then
		call UnitAddAbility(u,'A09M')
		call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A09M',3)
		call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A09M')
		call UnitAddAbility(u,'A09Q')
		call UnitAddAbility(u,'A09R')
	endif
	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(Jd,'A0EL')>0 and GetRandomInt(0,99)<30)then
		call UnitAddAbility(u,'A0EZ')
		call UnitAddAbility(u,'A0C5')
	endif
	call gB(u)
	set Mi[GI]=Mi[GI]+1
	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A07M')>=1)then
		call NB(u)
		call GroupAddUnit(er,u)
	endif
endfunction

handlers.name: rk
handlers.body:
function rk takes nothing returns nothing
	local unit u=GetSummonedUnit()
	local integer wR=GetUnitTypeId(u)
	if(wR=='h03C')then
		call SetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_MANA,30.)
	elseif(wR=='h03A')then
		call TriggerSleepAction(.7)
		call IssueImmediateOrderById(u,$D0057)
		call TriggerSleepAction(.1)
	elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A07M')>0)then
		call NB(u)
		call GroupAddUnit(er,u)
	elseif(wR=='h030')then
		call UnitRemoveType(u,UNIT_TYPE_SUMMONED)
		if(GetUnitTypeId(GetSummoningUnit())=='h030')then
			set u=ReplaceUnitBJ(u,'h02Z',2)
		else
			call ok(u,GetSummoningUnit())
		endif
	endif
	call CB(u)
	set u=null
endfunction

handlers.name: Sk
handlers.body:
function Sk takes nothing returns nothing
local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
local integer tk=GetSpellAbilityId()
if(IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE))then
if(tk=='A09A')then
call yC(u,(Gv[GetUnitPointValue((u))]))
elseif(tk=='A0EK')then
call ab(u,GetSpellTargetUnit())
else
call VI(u)
endif
elseif(tk=='A005')then
call pk(u,GetSpellTargetX(),GetSpellTargetY())
elseif(tk=='A08Y')then
call qk(u,GetSpellTargetX(),GetSpellTargetY())
elseif(tk>='IBA0' and tk<='IBA8')then
call Qk(u,tk-'IBA0')
else
call OI(u,tk,GetSpellTargetUnit())
endif
set u=null
endfunction

limits: No original WC3 frame-by-frame runtime comparison or physical Android test.
Native Defend reflection edge cases, artillery fire pulse boundaries and prayer timing need original-engine confirmation.

Wizard pf retreat/rest and temporary mana aura removal are ported; navigation uses Godot paths, and the requested150 damage/5s ground-only balance remains. Native eh low-health recovery is outside this transferred cycle.
Native LightningData texture/width/duration are used, but strip scrolling is a port renderer rather than original spline/noise behavior.
Buff artwork comes from clean w3h because the current export does not contain w3h or a current binary w3a; shared Inner Fire/Prayer buff interactions need runtime comparison.
